text: Which of the following curve represents the first order reaction ?

options.label: A
options.text: A plot of \(t_{1/2}\) (vertical axis) against \([\mathrm{R}]_0\) (horizontal axis) : a straight line of positive slope rising from the origin.

options.label: B
options.text: A plot of \(t_{1/2}\) (vertical axis) against \([\mathrm{R}]_0\) (horizontal axis) : a horizontal straight line.

options.label: C
options.text: A plot of Rate (vertical axis) against Concentration (horizontal axis) : a horizontal straight line.

options.label: D
options.text: A plot of Rate (vertical axis) against Concentration (horizontal axis) : a curve falling steeply and then levelling off.
